description: This is a Kotlin source file defining a RecyclerView.Adapter implementation named ProductAdapter for displaying a list of products in an Android application. It manages product items, handles loading footers, animations for dataset changes, and user interactions such as favoriting products.

classes.name: ProductAdapter
classes.description: RecyclerView adapter for displaying a list of Product items, with support for loading footer, diffing, and item interactions.

classes.name: ProductVH
classes.description: ViewHolder class for displaying individual Product items, handles binding product data and favorite icon state.

classes.name: LoadingVH
classes.description: ViewHolder class for displaying a loading indicator at the bottom of the list.

methods.name: submit
methods.description: Replaces the entire list of products and updates the repository reference.

methods.name: submitWithFooter
methods.description: Replaces the list of products and sets whether to display the loading footer.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Appends more products to the existing list, facilitating pagination.

methods.name: setLoadingFooterVisible
methods.description: Shows or hides the loading footer at the end of the list.

methods.name: submitInternal
methods.description: Internal method to update the list and compute diffs for smooth animations.

methods.name: getItemId
methods.description: Returns a stable ID for items, using hash code for products and a fixed ID for the loading footer.

methods.name: getItemViewType
methods.description: Determines whether a position corresponds to a product or a loading footer.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Inflates view layouts for product items or loading footers based on view type.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data to view holders for products or loading indicator.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder (overload with payloads)
methods.description: Handles partial bind updates, e.g., updating favorite state efficiently.

methods.name: notifyFavoriteChanged
methods.description: Notify that a product's favorite status changed, causing a row refresh.
